exam_scheme.note: Conducted in accordance with the National Council for Teacher Education (NCTE) statutory guidelines under Section 23(1) of the Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education (RTE) Act, 2009. The examination comprises two separate objective papers: Paper-I for Primary Teachers (Classes I to V) and Paper-II for Upper Primary / Elementary Teachers (Classes VI to VIII). Each paper consists of 150 multiple-choice questions (150 marks) of 150 minutes duration with no negative marking. Minimum qualifying standard is 60% (90 out of 150 marks) for General category candidates, with a 5% relaxation to 55% (82 out of 150 marks) for Arunachal Pradesh Scheduled Tribe (APST) and reserved category candidates. Qualified candidates receive a Teacher Eligibility Test certificate with lifetime validity.
